appDesc.message: Unloads background tabs you haven't used in a while, replacing them with a one-click Reactivate page.

popupNoSiteNote.message: Only ordinary web pages can be excluded — this one has no site to add.

popupExcludedThrough.message: Excluded through $1, which also covers its subdomains.

popupFlashExcluded.message: Excluded — $1 stays awake from now on.

popupFlashIncluded.message: Included — $1 can be put to sleep again.

optionsSub.message: Unload tabs you haven't touched in a while. Changes save automatically.

optionsBackgroundOnly.message: Only background tabs are unloaded, never the one you're looking at.

optionsDomainsHint.message: One per line (or comma separated). A domain also covers its subdomains, so example.com excludes app.example.com too.

optionsThemeHint.message: Used by the page shown on sleeping tabs.

errorMinutesPositive.message: Enter a number of minutes greater than 0.

errorMinutesMax.message: Keep it at $1 minutes or less.

domainsIgnoredOne.message: Ignored one entry that isn't a domain: $1.

statusSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save — check that Chrome sync is available.

statusResetFailed.message: Couldn't reset — check that Chrome sync is available.

confirmReset.message: Reset every setting to its default? Your excluded sites will be removed.

dormantHeading.message: This tab was put to sleep.

dormantUnused.message: It went unused long enough to be unloaded.

dormantNoAddress.message: Its address wasn't recorded — use the browser's Back button to return to it.

dormantReason.message: Unloaded after $1 without use, to free memory.

dormantTip.message: Press Enter or $1 to reopen it, or use the browser's Back button.

dormantReopenFailed.message: Couldn't reopen this page. Use the browser's Back button instead.

dormantExcludeFailed.message: Couldn't update the exclusion list. Try again from the toolbar popup.
